source.title: A lighting strategy for Lunar Orbiter mission design

questions: Is film response represented as an exposure-dependent derivative or slope?
Is rms density granularity represented as a separately measured exposure-dependent function?
Is density noise transformed to transmission noise explicitly?
Is scanning aperture treated as a separate measurement/system variable?
Does machine-readable text provide a reusable numeric granularity-versus-exposure table?

branch_rule.source_pass_numeric_table: Open a separately frozen no-fit numerical compatibility audit; do not fit or calibrate.
branch_rule.source_pass_no_numeric_table: Retain qualitative mechanism constraints only; explicitly test whether they support or limit the P4AD interpretation, with no curve fitting.
branch_rule.source_fail: Close this source without alternate mirrors, OCR, figure digitization or rights relaxation.

forbidden: treating lunar-orbiter film as a modern photographic stock
fitting P4AF amplitude, correlation or marginal
stock, process, scanner, calibration or product claims
claim_ceiling: Primary-source mechanism and measurement-boundary evidence for historical photographic film noise; not reusable stock data, measured modern emulsion parameters, calibration or product evidence.
